subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about moving {Brand}'s free-tier base onto a paid plan, the way Notion and Grammarly run their US acquisition. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the first paid subscription and read every paid event back through server-side store validation before it counts, so the optimization trains on confirmed revenue at a trial-to-paid of 36%. If it helps, I can share the activation-to-renewal view for a comparable utility. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate paid-subscription validation proof
illustrative_flags: trial-to-paid of 36% (MobUpps-specific quality signal; illustrative placeholder, calibrated to the productivity trial-to-paid band)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN utility_and_productivity: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to first paid subscription + server-side store validation); one illustrative MobUpps figure (trial-to-paid 36%); reuses parent brands Notion/Grammarly only; soft CTA, one question mark; native US B2B register; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; no em-dash.
